sentences.text: This petition has been filed assailing the discharge of the accused in FIR No.198/2013 PS Crime Women Cell under Sections 498A/406 IPC.
The matter was referred to mediation and it has been unsuccessful.

2. Counsel for the parties shall place a note of arguments of not more than three pages synopsising the contentions along with the pdf pages of the TCR and the citations that they wish to rely upon which will be exchanged between the parties at least a week before the next date of hearing.

3. List on 24th September, 2024.
4. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
